canonicalProducerSites.condition: Any canonical lineage item contains deferredItemReplacement, deferredItemRemoval or itemReplacement, or its subscription row contains outOfAppPurchaseContext. Field presence, even empty, rejects; every lineage row is checked.
Head normalized state pending or pending_canceled with more than one linked token hash.

Access expiry and funded-order end fail exact equality when allow_access_extension false, or access expiry is less than funded end under true. Non-bool extension option also rejects. Deployed lifecycle=false means exact equality is required.
No exact operation receipt, retained paid source has a non-null headTokenDigest, and prior head is absent from freshly verified token lineage. No exception for expired or INACTIVE old source.

writerMigrationFence.condition: Existing paid source subscriptionDigest differs from new verified root subscription digest, or supplied source revision moves backwards, even if old source is expired/INACTIVE.

functionalFixDecision: No safe grant/migration behavior change justified from the retained evidence. Preserve all guards and existing ownership/usage/ACK policy.

minimumNextEvidence.sourceOnlyCandidate: Finite internal original-site predicate metadata with Dev/exact-route/existing-gate guards; public error/status/retryability unchanged, no raw provider response, token, order/account/request identifier, claim, exception text or extra provider call.
minimumNextEvidence.requiredBeforeAnyDeployment: Separate exact reviewed source/artifact/deployment authorization. This diagnosis does not authorize it.
minimumNextEvidence.historicalLimit: Cannot reconstruct original predicate from public code/stage; no proof replay, purchase, endpoint or lifecycle activation is authorized.
minimumNextEvidence.ifRepurchaseSupportRequired: Explicit atomic migration design across Handoff and writer with previous-source/period/global-usage, ownership, deletion, device, CAS, replay and race tests; preserve historical spending and reject overlap/cross-owner transfer.
